title: Pyne Pod Lemon Lime Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pyne Pod NicSalts Lemon Lime 10ml E-Liquid delivers a brilliantly sharp and intensely refreshing citrus experience. The blend begins with the bright, clean tartness of fresh Lemon, offering an immediate zesty impact on the inhale. This is flawlessly complemented by the slightly sweeter, aromatic bite of tangy Lime on the exhale. Together, they create a highly vibrant, balanced profile that cleanses the palate and remains satisfyingly punchy. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Pyne Pod Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Pyne Pod Nic Salts collection translates the intense, highly popular flavours of their renowned prefilled pods into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the sharp citrus bite of Lemon Lime, vapers can explore other irresistible blends such as the sweet nostalgia of Blue Razz GB, the dark fruit depths of Blackberry Blackcurrant, or the cool finish of Strawberry Kiwi Ice.
